name: compass
description: A suite of conversational thinking tools — reflect (Socratic mirror, never recommends, always saves), mull (thinking partner, probes AND contributes opinions, saves substantive sessions only), and converge (advisor, leads with a researched recommendation plus confidence % and refines it one question at a time). Plus a paired evaluation track: first-principles (evidence-first interview that produces a signed-off needs map before any option is named) hands off to solution-research (turns that map into a systems-first parallel-research handoff prompt).
